style: Detailed black ink line art illustration in the style of a hand-inked coloring book page. Clean, confident black outlines with varied line weight and fine texture detail: wood grain, feathers, foliage, stone, rope, ripples on water. Pure white background. Black lines only: no color, no gray tones, no shading gradients, no large solid black areas. Wide landscape composition. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no signature, no border, no frame.

scenes.gull-rock-cover: A tall stone lighthouse on a small rocky island, a low slate-roofed keeper's cottage beside it, waves breaking on the rocks below, wisps of sea fog, gulls wheeling in the sky, the lighthouse lamp shining with drawn rays of light.
scenes.mailboat: A small wooden motor boat with a little wheelhouse approaching a rocky island through drifting fog; a lighthouse stands dark on the island; a bearded boatman at the wheel; gentle waves and seagulls.
scenes.cottage-kitchen: Inside a cosy stone cottage kitchen: a wooden table with an unfinished bowl of stew, a mug of tea and a loaf of bread, a chair pushed back, an open ledger book, a cast iron stove, oilskins on hooks, and a fat cat sitting by an empty bowl.
scenes.logbook: Close-up of an old open logbook on a wooden table, pages full of handwritten lines, a pencil lying in the gutter, a brass oil lamp and a folded note beside it.
scenes.tower-stairs: Looking up an iron spiral staircase winding up inside a lighthouse tower, rivets and railings, a small round window, the stairs curling up toward a hatch at the top.
scenes.lamp-lens: The lamp room at the top of a lighthouse: a huge glass Fresnel lens like a beehive of prisms with a glowing lamp inside, beams of light radiating out through the tall windows, brass fittings, a gallery railing outside.
scenes.davy: A young boy in an oversized wool jumper and knitted hat sitting on wet seaweed-covered rocks holding his ankle, a small wooden rowing skiff pulled up in a crack of the rocks behind him, sea fog.
scenes.gallery: Two small figures, an adult and a boy, standing on the iron gallery balcony at the top of a lighthouse, the boy pointing out to sea, a broad beam of light sweeping over fog and the sea below.
scenes.signal-lamp: A person on a lighthouse balcony holding a heavy hand signal lamp with a shutter, flashes of light streaming out over the foggy sea toward a distant steamship.
scenes.boathouse: A stone boathouse on a rocky shore with its wide doors standing open and empty inside, a slipway running down to the water with a long scrape in the seaweed, coils of rope and oars, drifting fog.
scenes.radio: An old 1950s radio telephone set in a wooden cabinet on a desk, round dials and knobs, a heavy black handset on a curly cord, a small window looking out at a lighthouse beam in the dark.
scenes.rowing-fog: A lone figure rowing a small wooden boat through thick sea fog at night, oars dipping into dark water, a lighthouse beam sweeping overhead in the distance.
scenes.ada-hollow: A small elderly woman with short grey hair, wrapped in an oilskin coat, wedged into a hollow among jagged sea rocks, one leg stretched out injured, spray from waves rising around her.
scenes.reef-lantern: A hurricane lantern hung from a tall wooden pole wedged among jagged black reef rocks, rays of light from the lantern, waves foaming between the rocks, a dark sea.
scenes.launch-searchlight: A low motor launch idling in the fog with two men aboard, a searchlight on its bow throwing a long beam across jagged rocks and choppy water.
scenes.sea-cave: The mouth of a sea cave in a rocky cliff, waves surging in and out, a narrow ledge running along the inside wall, seaweed and barnacles on the rocks.
scenes.crates: Inside a sea cave: wooden cargo crates and barrels stacked on a plank platform, a hurricane lamp hanging from a nail on the rock wall casting light, rope and a tarpaulin.
scenes.moored-launch: A long motor launch tied up in a narrow rocky inlet at night, a coil of rope, crowbars and sacks in its stern, calm water reflecting the rocks.
scenes.flare: A distress flare bursting high in the night sky over a rocky shore, three small figures on the rocks looking up, a lighthouse in the background, waves below.
scenes.reef-flare: A burning flare hanging in the sky over a reef of jagged rocks, a motor launch drifting with its engine dead, two men in the boat, an old woman sitting on the rocks.
scenes.lifeboat: A sturdy lifeboat and a small police launch emerging together from thick fog on a choppy sea, a crewman standing in the bow with a coiled line.
scenes.ghost-ship: The faint outline of an old three-masted sailing ship emerging from fog at night, square sails, rigging, a row of small lanterns glowing along her rail, mist curling around her hull.
scenes.steamer: The towering bow of a large steamship looming out of fog over a tiny rowing boat, a figure in the little boat waving a torch over their head, waves curling along the steamer's hull.
scenes.cat: A fat contented cat sitting upright on a rock by the sea at night, wearing a collar with a little tag, a brass flare pistol lying on the rock beside it.
scenes.dawn-tower: A lighthouse on a rocky island at sunrise, the sun rising over a calm sea with rays of light, a keeper's cottage with smoke curling from the chimney, seagulls flying.
scenes.wreck: Underwater view of the wooden ribs of an old sunken ship half buried in sand and seaweed, a small brass lantern sinking down through the water toward it, fish and bubbles.
scenes.gallery-night: Two people sitting on the gallery balcony of a lighthouse at night with a flask of tea and a blanket, a cat curled between them, stars overhead and the lamp's beam sweeping out to sea.
scenes.inkwold-cover: A winding road drawn across a landscape like an old engraved map: pine forests, a meandering river, rolling hills, and a tall mountain with a domed stone observatory-like building on its peak; in the foreground a large crow perched on a gnarled tree branch, looking along the road.
scenes.map-shop: An old map maker's shop: a drawing table with a large map pinned flat at the corners, an ink road on the map drawing itself, a quill pen, ink pots, a globe in a brass stand, shelves and cabinets of rolled maps, a pair of spectacles on the counter.
scenes.journal: An old leather-bound journal lying open, stuffed with loose pages, its pages covered in sketches of mountains, maps, notes in the margins and ink blots, a pressed flower tucked in.
scenes.crow: A large crow perched on top of a wooden signpost with two blank arrow-shaped signs pointing in opposite directions, grass and a few rocks at the foot of the post.
scenes.whisperwood: A dark enchanted forest of tall twisted trees drawn like an old engraving, a narrow pale path running between them, ferns curling at their roots, a figure with a crow on their shoulder walking the path.
scenes.tinker: A round, cheerful tinker woman in a patchwork coat pushing a wooden handcart hung with pots, pans, kettles and little brass instruments along a forest path.
scenes.lantern-hollow: A round hollow in a forest ringed by trees, a long feast table with candles, roast chicken, bread and pies in the middle, glowing lanterns floating in the air above it.
scenes.drawn-door: A tall wooden door standing on its own in the middle of a forest with no wall around it, slightly crooked as if hand drawn, a person holding a pen beside it, trees all around.
scenes.ferry: A tall hooded ferryman standing on a flat wooden ferry with a lantern on a pole, poling across a wide calm river, misty far bank, reeds in the foreground.
scenes.memory-river: Looking down into a calm river where images float under the surface: a snowman, a birthday cake with candles, a dog, a small boat; a hand trailing in the water from the edge of a raft.
scenes.raft: An old log raft lashed with rope drifting on a wide river, a person standing with a long pole, a crow perched on the end log, reeds and misty banks.
scenes.crossroads: A stone signpost at a crossroads where four roads meet, a great mountain rising behind it with a domed library on the peak, and on one side the road simply stops at a blank edge where the world ends.
scenes.glass-city: A city of tall slender glass towers with pointed roofs, bridges between them, crowds of travelers with bundles and carts in the streets, and a small cable car climbing on a wire toward a mountain.
scenes.word-shop: A narrow old shop lined floor to ceiling with tiny shelves, each holding a single slip of paper, an elderly woman with very thick round spectacles behind the counter holding up one slip.
scenes.cable-car: A small cable car hanging from a wire high above a valley of forests and rivers, a person clinging to the outside of the car, mountains in the distance.
scenes.ink-stair: A steep zigzag stone staircase carved into the side of a cliff, a small stone hut with a turf roof and smoking chimney on a ledge halfway up, a goat tethered outside, clouds below.
scenes.hermit: An old hermit with a long white beard sitting outside a stone hut, unrolling a detailed map of a mountain across his knees, a goat nearby, mountain peaks behind.
scenes.above-clouds: A domed stone library with columns standing on a mountain summit above a sea of clouds, other peaks rising from the clouds like islands, sunlight streaming.
scenes.library-door: Two enormous wooden doors carved all over with maps, coastlines and compass roses, standing a crack open with light spilling through the gap, stone steps leading up to them.
scenes.library-dome: Inside a vast round library under a great dome, curving shelves of maps and scrolls rising many storeys with ladders and spiral stairs, an old man with spectacles drawing at a round desk in the centre lit by a lamp.
scenes.two-pens: Two hands, one old and one young, drawing side by side with pens on one large map spread across a desk, shelves of maps rising in the background.
scenes.silver-pen: A hand raising a long silver pen high, rays of light bursting out from its nib, maps and pages swirling around it in a great library.
scenes.the-blank: A detailed landscape of trees, hills and a road that ends abruptly at a clean straight edge, beyond which is nothing but empty white paper; half a tree at the edge; a small figure standing looking into the blankness.
scenes.slide: A long wobbly slide drawn down the side of a mountain, curving through clouds with one loop in it, two people and a crow sliding down, a wooden door standing alone at the bottom.
scenes.new-road: A road being drawn out into empty white space by a giant pen nib, grass, wildflowers and young trees springing up along its edges as it goes, hills appearing in the distance.
scenes.shop-sign: The front of an old map shop on a cobbled street, a bell over the door, bow windows, a hanging sign with a little map painted on it, and a crow perched on top of the sign.
scenes.long-quiet-cover: Cross-section coloring page: a thick ice ceiling drawn with crack lines across the top, a research station of rounded cylindrical modules with round portholes hanging beneath it on struts, a small round bubble-canopy submarine below, and lower down a loose spiral of small outlined jellyfish-like glowing creatures. The water is white paper, shown only with a few gentle wavy lines and small bubbles. Smooth unmarked hulls.
scenes.sickbay: A small spacecraft-style sick bay: a single bed with a thin blanket, a drip stand, medical monitors on the wall, cabinets, and a round porthole showing dark water.
scenes.scan: A medical screen on a wall showing a row of brain scan slices, a small bright spot on each one shrinking from left to right, a keyboard below.
scenes.corridor: A long narrow corridor in an underwater research station, ribbed curved walls, pipes and cables along the ceiling, strip lights along the floor, round hatches on both sides, frost on a porthole.
scenes.cabin: A tiny crew cabin in a research station: a bunk, a round porthole, a photograph of two children on a beach pinned to the wall beside a child's crayon drawing of a rocket, a fold-down desk.
scenes.operations: An operations room in a research station: a curved console of screens, the main screen showing a sound waveform, several empty chairs pushed back from the console.
scenes.waveform: A large screen showing groups of sound pulses in a row, two, then three, then five, then seven, then eleven, with a flowing waveform below them.
scenes.lab: A biology lab bench with a row of glass sample tanks full of seawater, each tank filled with tiny glowing specks of light, microscopes, notebooks and small potted plants.
scenes.greenhouse: A long greenhouse inside a research station: racks of lettuce, beans and tomato vines in hydroponic trays with water channels, and at the end a tall sunflower with a glowing point of light in its centre.
scenes.reactor: An engineering room around a squat cylindrical reactor wrapped in pipes, valves and gauges, a control panel with switches and a covered red switch.
scenes.pipes: A cramped access space crowded with pipes and hoses, a person in a thick jacket rerouting a hose with clamps by the light of a torch held in their teeth.
scenes.comms: A communications room: a large screen showing a tired grey-haired woman at a desk with people crowded behind her, a microphone and headset on the console in front of it.
scenes.moonpool: A round pool of open ocean in the floor of an underwater station, a metal walkway with railings around it, a small round submarine hanging in a cradle above, the water full of tiny glowing specks.
scenes.transmitter: A laptop on a folding table beside the railing of a round pool of open water, cables running down into the water, circular ripples spreading across the surface.
scenes.visitor: A tall humanlike figure made of thousands of tiny glowing points of light rising out of a round pool of water, long trailing fronds instead of hands reaching toward a person kneeling on the walkway.
scenes.remora: A small round two-seat submarine with a bubble canopy and folded mechanical arms descending through dark water, its floodlights cutting beams through drifting specks and tiny glowing lights.
scenes.vents: Tall rocky hydrothermal chimneys on the deep sea floor billowing plumes of water, strange coral-like glowing towers and arches built between them, a clear dome resting on the seabed.
scenes.dome: Inside a clear dome on the sea floor: five people asleep on beds of soft moss in a ring around a small submarine, glowing fronds hanging down from the dome's roof resting on their foreheads.
scenes.crew: Six people in thermal jackets standing together inside a glassy dome on the sea floor, looking up in wonder at thousands of tiny lights swirling overhead.
scenes.two-subs: Two small submarines rising side by side through dark ocean water, their floodlights shining, a cloud of tiny glowing lights rising with them.
scenes.signal-up: A single beam of light pointing straight up through dark water from a small lamp on the seabed, and thousands of tiny glowing lights all around turning to point upward with it.
scenes.choir-mind: A vast slow spiral of countless tiny glowing points of light spread through the deep ocean like a galaxy, with a few small human silhouettes floating in it.
scenes.winch: A large winch drum wound with heavy cable in an engineering room, the cable running down through a hatch in the floor into a deep shaft.
scenes.ascent-pod: A narrow capsule rising up a long shaft cut through thick ice, cracks and layers in the ice walls around it.
scenes.europa-sky: The cracked icy surface of a frozen moon under a black starry sky, a giant banded planet hanging huge above the horizon, a small spacecraft lander standing on the ice.
scenes.station: A research station hanging beneath a thick ceiling of ice in a dark ocean, a greenhouse module with glowing windows, a long shaft running up into the ice, and faint lights far below.
